selected_evidence.summary: Shows the initial state, repaired executable, installed `15 2 * * *` root cron entry, active/enabled crond, and the persisted schedule after restart.
Demonstrates successful output redirection, retained pre-restart content, and a second appended record after restart.

Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, running system state, recovered crond service, persisted schedule, retained data, and successful post-restart execution.

printf '%s\n' '--- schedulers ---'
systemctl is-active crond 2>&1 || true
systemctl is-enabled crond 2>&1 || true
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager | sed -n '1,30p'
printf '%s\n' '--- existing inventory scheduling ---'
systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager | grep -i inventory || true
find /etc/cron.d /etc/systemd/system -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*inventory*' -print 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- existing log ---'
if [ -e /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log ]; then ls -l /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log; tail -20 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log; else printf '%s\n' absent; fi

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 022
cat > /tmp/inventory-maintenance.new <<'ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_SCRIPT
/usr/bin/install -o root -g root -m 0755 /tmp/inventory-maintenance.new /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
rm -f /tmp/inventory-maintenance.new
restorecon /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance 2>/dev/null || true
cat > /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance <<'ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_CRON'
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1
ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_CRON
chown root:root /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
chmod 0644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
restorecon /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl reload crond
printf '%s\n' configured

set -eu
/bin/sh -c '/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
printf '%s\n' '--- scheduler service ---'
systemctl is-active crond
systemctl is-enabled crond
printf '%s\n' '--- installed command ---'
ls -lZ /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
sed -n '1,20p' /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
printf '%s\n' '--- installed schedule ---'
ls -lZ /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
printf '%s\n' '--- retained output ---'
ls -lZ /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
tail -5 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
printf '%s\n' '--- cron reload evidence ---'
journalctl -u crond --since '-5 minutes' --no-pager | tail -20
